preconditions.description: The input s is a string.
The input string contains only lowercase letters and no spaces.

postconditions.description: The function returns a list containing exactly two strings.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == ''.join(s[i].upper() if i % 2 == 0 else s[i] for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: The first string has letters at even indices capitalized and letters at odd indices unchanged.

postconditions.expression: return_value[1] == ''.join(s[i].upper() if i % 2 == 1 else s[i] for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: The second string has letters at odd indices capitalized and letters at even indices unchanged.
